verdict.rationale: OpenClaw exposes HTTP surfaces, including an OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoint and a tools-invoke endpoint, so a downloadable API spec is a fair question for this product. No OpenAPI or equivalent spec is documented, and the probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The A2A Agent Card, llms.txt, and MCP server are adjacent discovery features, not a downloadable API specification, so they earn no credit here.
